claims: Add her bot plus Grok bot; connect calendar and email to get your readings and packages arriving today
Prints newsletters you never have time to read, and draws a comic based on your life that can look like you
Printing starts automatically one hour before you wake up (setup asks 'What time do you usually wake up?')
how_to_steps: Open newspaper.karenx.com (link in bio) and add her bot and Grok bot
Connect a printer; the paper prints itself an hour before you wake
on_screen_only: Caption: 'i got an AI agent to make me a personalized newspaper'; 'POV: you want to stop checking your phone first thing'
Printed paper masthead 'The Karen Times' with items like 'Dentist at 3:30, Dinner with Maya at 7', weather '56 / 63'
Gmail screenshot: newsletter 'The next big thing is a smaller audience' from The Margin Note
Setup dialog: 'What time do you usually wake up? Or pick: Another time...' with time options
cta: Link in bio to try the bot

relevance.why: Fun consumer demo and a good example of a shareable agent product with a physical output, but built on Grok's bot platform (sponsored) and not related to our Claude Code workflow.

implement_score.why: Nothing to adopt. If we ever want a 'morning brief' artifact, we already have one; the print-to-paper gimmick is not worth the time.
